description: This file defines an abstract class 'LeaveAllocate' within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin, handling events related to leave allocation, including managing leave request details, workflow state, and performer information.

classes.name: LeaveAllocate
classes.description: An abstract class representing a leave allocation event, encapsulating leave request data, workflow state, and the user performing the action.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing leave request, workflow state, and performer user.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns a detailed leave request object, converting from a general leave request if necessary and fetching leave details.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the associated workflow state machine.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave allocation action.
